description.en:
Remote Dispatcher remotely starts and stops already-prepared AutoDrive and Courseplay tasks without entering the target vehicle.
Use the management screen to configure each vehicle's automation provider and HelperProfiles worker assignment. Use the lightweight in-game selector to choose the retained target, then press Ctrl+Alt+R to start or stop that vehicle remotely. The selector, target cycling and remote action are available both on foot and while driving another vehicle.
Version 0.3.0.4 moves localisation to the same l10n/l10n_<language>.xml layout already proven by HelperProfiles after FS25 failed to load the earlier translations/ layout. It retains the passive AutoDrive post-start diagnostics introduced in 0.3.0.3. Dispatch behaviour is unchanged. This public early alpha is released and supported with HelperProfiles 2.1.1.0, whose Integration API v7 provides scoped named-worker dispatch.
Early alpha. Single-player only. Back up important savegames before testing.

changelog.en:
0.3.0.4: - Moved English localisation to l10n/l10n_en.xml and aligned modDesc.xml with the proven HelperProfiles localisation convention. - Removed the previous translations/ localisation path after FS25 1.23.1.0 still failed to load it. - Updated validation to enforce the GIANTS filename convention prefix + _<language>.xml in both source and packaged ZIP. - No dispatch behaviour changes.
0.3.0.3: - Attempted to fix the GIANTS localisation filename-prefix mismatch for translations/l10n_en.xml. - Validation now derives and checks the localisation filename from modDesc.xml instead of assuming a repository path. - Added passive AutoDrive post-start observation to log unexpected early shutdowns without retrying or changing dispatch behaviour. - No AutoDrive/Courseplay start, stop, wake, HelperProfiles or persistence behaviour changes.
0.3.0.2: - Added missing English localisation for the Management automation-provider action. - Added missing English localisation for the Management worker-assignment action. - Strengthened release validation so every declared Remote Dispatcher input action must have a matching localisation entry. - No AutoDrive, Courseplay, HelperProfiles, persistence, wake or dispatch behaviour changes in this maintenance alpha.
0.3.0.1: - Added Remote Dispatcher input actions to the FS25 vehicle input context. - The target selector can now be opened while driving another vehicle. - Previous/next target cycling now works while driving. - Ctrl+Alt+R can now start/stop the retained remote target while the player is in another vehicle. - Management can now be opened from the vehicle context. - Changed the default Management shortcut from Ctrl+Alt+M to Ctrl+Alt+J to avoid AutoDrive's notification-history binding.
0.3.0.0: - First public early-alpha release. - Added per-save persistence keyed to FS25 vehicle unique IDs. - Automation provider and HelperProfiles worker assignments now survive save reloads. - The retained cinematic target is restored when the save is reopened. - Added rdStatus support diagnostics for alpha testing. - Retained the two-pane management GUI and measured in-game target selector from 0.2.2.0. - Named worker assignment uses HelperProfiles Integration API v7. - Public alpha support requires HelperProfiles 2.1.1.0. - Named-worker dispatch is fail-closed when the requested worker is missing, OFF roster or already active.
0.2.2.0: - Restored explicit two-pane worker assignment in Management. - Reworked the live selector with measured columns and dynamic sizing. - Kept Management configuration separate from the live cinematic target.
